title: Unveiling Visual Biases in Audio-Visual Localization Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying 'visual bias' in datasets used for audio-visual source localization (AVSL). It uses a Large Vision-Language Model (MiniGPT-v2) as a tool to demonstrate that visual cues alone are often sufficient to identify sound sources, but it does not evaluate or discuss religion, faith, theology, or moral/ethical frameworks.
